note: City of Medicine Hat campground in the coulees off the Trans-Canada Highway and 7 Street SW: shady, irrigated grass sites, across from the WestVue Dog Park and on the city's Heritage Trail network; community fire pit and kitchen, two accessible comfort cabins. --Claude
